schedule: One Codex heartbeat daily at 09:00 Europe/Moscow

agents.daily_work: Preflight, CRM queue, owner facts, suppression, priorities, dispatch, sequential CRM writes and coverage reconciliation
Read CRM health and available traffic data at startup; final daily digest and coverage checks at completion
Advance one eligible existing SEO task or evidence-based local patch; Monday deeper audit; avoid unchanged recrawls
Research or enrich the active buyer-intent brief; check demand, sources and cannibalization; up to three new topics per week
Continue the one active article from a reviewed brief, then fact-check and prepare local publication materials
Advance a real existing case draft, headings, proof or internal-link task from verified portfolio facts
Public direct-client research, freshness, evidence and scoring; up to five new candidates
Public studio/agency partnership research and qualification; up to five new candidates
Public remote jobs/contracts research and qualification; up to five new candidates
Check qualified eligible CRM queue and write up to three personalized drafts from saved evidence only
Research or enrich a relevant editorial/link opportunity within shared weekly distribution cap; local proposals only
Check existing-profile inventory and advance one local profile/distribution proposal within shared cap; no public edits or account creation

rules: Every role must have a dated coverage entry each run; do not silently drop a role because jobs consumed the run.
Coverage entries contain agent, status, reason, evidence/artifacts and actual agent_run_id when executed.
A coverage entry is not proof of execution. Never create fictitious succeeded agent_runs for unexecuted work.
no_eligible_work requires an actual queue/eligibility check and a concrete reason, such as cooldown, no verified brief or exhausted weekly cap.
A missing permission/source/dependency is blocked; a tool/runtime error is failed, never successful coverage.
If preflight blocks the run, record dependent roles as blocked without executing or claiming them completed.
Delegate independent public research in waves within concurrency limits; keep dependent work and CRM writes sequential.
Do not force new records or output to fill quotas. Continue existing articles, cases and tasks rather than duplicate them.
Append important lifecycle events and log real executions in agent_runs; external_actions always zero.
